title: Turn forward observations into an exact joint inverse-response consistency family
statement: For global F=mI+A with Lip(A)<=a<m in a fixed Euclidean space, F is bijective and F^-1=cI+B, c=m/(m^2-a^2),Lip(B)<=b=a/(m^2-a^2). For any finite old/future force-position pairs, ||(z_u-z_v)-c*(q_u-q_v)||<=b*||q_u-q_v|| for every pair is necessary and sufficient for one compatible global source. Retain future-to-future constraints.

requires: Global stable F on R^d, supplied Euclidean shifted bound m>0,0<=a<m and exact full-vector forward observations.
Keep all old-old, old-future and future-future constraints; candidate forces/positions use the same source and units.
provides: For global F=mI+A with Lip(A)<=a<m in a fixed Euclidean space, F is bijective and F^-1=cI+B, c=m/(m^2-a^2),Lip(B)<=b=a/(m^2-a^2). For any finite old/future force-position pairs, ||(z_u-z_v)-c*(q_u-q_v)||<=b*||q_u-q_v|| for every pair is necessary and sufficient for one compatible global source. Retain future-to-future constraints.
assumptions: Not every strongly monotone Lipschitz map has this particular shifted bound.
Global extension gives the declared Lipschitz class, not extra smoothness, a physical realization or a native inverse instrument.
costs: d returned scalars per forward call; O((N+k)^2) constraints and k*d unknowns. Exact conic optimization needs its own arithmetic/runtime and validation budget.
contract.units: m,a are response/input slopes; c,b input/response; z has input units and q response units.
contract.obstruction: Justify the actual source class and validate solver residual/dual evidence before using numerical extrema.

body: Solve x=(p-A(x))/m by contraction. Completing squares turns ||h-m*d||^2<=a^2*||d||^2 into ||d-c*h||^2<=b^2*||h||^2; c>b gives converse bijectivity. Extend the finite inverse residual labels by the written minimax/variance Lipschitz extension proof, then invert cI+B. For N old/k future pairs the exact model family has O((N+k)^2) convex SOC constraints in k*d unknowns and needs no new source calls. This is an exact representation, not a free exact optimization algorithm. With m3,a1,F(0)=0, forces(2,0),(2,1/50) have sharp relative vertical interval[1/200,1/100], attained by F=(3x,4y) and(3x,2y). Independent marginal decoding gives width at least1 versus1/200; this200-fold example largely uses the supplied class, not an acquired general learning advantage. No differentiable/physical extension is guaranteed.

review.scope: Completed source-exposed intake-author reconstruction of Banach bijectivity, the completed-square inverse equivalence and finite Lipschitz extension argument; same-source relative witness; Slater/KKT/conical sparse support with a bounded nonempty historical family; weighted-square outer certificate; exact saturation geometry, adversarial-noise ambiguity and hidden-bump global-contract failure; projected-VI fixed point and strong-monotonicity history ball, including an independent rational two-dose counterexample to projecting an inverse. Eight saved focused endpoint certificates were independently recomputed using Fraction arithmetic from the six recorded native pairs, including outward square roots; this validates conditional saved bounds, not independent measurement or whole-suite execution. Archive/member/manifest identity, recorded costs, actual bit lengths and saved VI baseline equality were inspected. All four original research programs and verifier were statically read, not run. Numerical search optimality, reported replay, physical validity, novelty and architecture advantage are outside acceptance.
